title: Dilated Balanced cross entropy loss for medical image segmentation
mechanism: Class-balancing CE weights computed on dilated class masks, so each class and its surrounding band share the balancing weight.
adaptation: Dilate crack by 2 px (and inactive by 2 px) for the weight computation so the jitter band is not punished as hard background; replace CE in the house loss.
min_experiment: Arm: DBCE + house Dice, 5 seeds. Baseline: house. Metrics: crack IoU, relF1@2, pixel P/R. Kill: crack IoU and relF1@2 both within noise (< 0.012 / < 0.005).
evidence: Several medical datasets: beats balanced CE by a large margin; similar or better than Dice + CE.
prior_overlap: Offset-tolerant CE (n.d.) is related but changes target placement, not class balance; not the same mechanism.
